name: Waterfall
author: support@cinammon.net
description: Waterfall is a fork of the well-known BungeeCord server teleportation suite.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Waterfall Installation Script for Cinammon.net
PROJECT=waterfall
: ${USER_AGENT:='cinammon.net/panel'}
: ${SERVER_JARFILE:='waterfall.jar'}
: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION:='latest'}

if [ -n "${DL_LINK}" ]; then
    echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_LINK}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(eval echo $(echo ${DL_LINK} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g'))
else
    API_PROJECT=$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}")

    if [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ]; then
        MINECRAFT_VERSION=$(echo "$API_PROJECT" | jq -r '.versions | to_entries | .[].value[]' | grep -v '-' | head -n1)
    fi

    echo -e "Waterfall Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"

    API_BUILDS=$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}")

    if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ]; then
        BUILD_NUMBER=$(echo "$API_BUILDS" | jq -r '.builds | max')
    fi

    echo -e "Waterfall Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"

    API_BUILD_INFO=$(curl -s -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}")
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "$API_BUILD_INFO" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].url // empty')

    if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ]; then
        JAR_NAME=$(echo "$API_BUILD_INFO" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].name // empty')
        if [ -z "$JAR_NAME" ]; then
            JAR_NAME="${PROJECT}-${MINECRAFT_VERSION}-${BUILD_NUMBER}.jar"
        fi
        DOWNLOAD_URL="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}"
    fi
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "Downloading Waterfall from: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi

curl -sSL -H "User-Agent: ${USER_AGENT}" -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ ! -d plugins ]; then
    mkdir -p plugins
fi

echo -e "Waterfall installation complete!"
